title: The frozen axis: Ledrappier's law measures distance in signed bits
claim: The frozen axis. In Ledrappier's law x(i,j)+x(i+1,j)+x(i,j+1)=0 on Z^2 (no finite moves), a set of sites is an implied check exactly when the sum of X^a(1+X)^b over it vanishes in F2(X); there are no one- or two-point checks, so every vanishing set of at most five points is a knot. (1) The three-point knots are exactly the Frobenius triangles {c, c+2^e e1, c+2^e e2} (Mason-Stothers in characteristic 2 with Frobenius descent), so every point has bond distance 2 to six points at every power-of-two separation and every bond ball of radius >= 2 is infinite. (2) For every signed-binary representation n = sum of k terms +-2^e with distinct exponents, the hop set (one Frobenius triangle per hop) is a knot of k+2 points through (0,0) and (n,0), minimal by (1+X)-adic valuations; with the non-adjacent form, bond distance along each lattice line is at most 1 + w(n) <= (log2 n)/2 + 5/2, and equals 2 exactly at powers of two. (3) Not proved, a conjecture with finite evidence: bond distance = 1 + w(n), and in the plane 1 + |v|_D (signed powers of two along e1, e2, e1-e2); no smaller knot exists for n <= 128 (sizes <= 4) or for n = 43, 45, 51, 53 (size 5) inside stated windows, and the plane formula holds for all 168 vectors of [-6,6]^2 (exactly for |v|_D <= 3). Not every four-point knot is two triangles sharing a point: {(0,0),(3,0),(0,3),(1,1)} is a knot.
failure_conditions: A three-point knot of Ledrappier's law that is not a Frobenius triangle, or a Frobenius triangle that is not a knot.
An n for which the signed-binary construction fails to be a knot of size 2 + w(n) through (0,0) and (n,0).
A knot through (0,0) and (n,0) with fewer than 2 + w(n) points (refutes the conjecture).
foundation_claim_scope: Ledrappier's law on Z^2 (source-blind K1-K3 verdicts; under the source-aware reading none of its knots is native). Items 1-2 for all scales by proof; checks on a side-24 patch, the window [-32,32]^2, n <= 2048, and the stated lower-bound windows.

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-11-07.
validation.status: prose proofs of items 1-2; check.py runs six checks with rejected controls; the polynomial model is checked against Gaussian elimination on the patch law; the lower bound is a conjecture checked only in windows; no human or external review
validation.novelty: known-overlap-found: the Frobenius triangles are Ledrappier's non-mixing shapes (Ledrappier 1978) and three-term unit equations in characteristic p are classical (Mason-Stothers; Masser 2004; Derksen-Masser 2012); the delta, not found in the literature, is the signed-binary hop construction of minimal relations through two given points, its minimality proof by (1+X)-adic valuations, the conjectured exact formula, and the reading as the bond distance of a frozen law.
